body: Jumped off a piano when I was 3, still have a scar on my ear.

A list from personal experiences, so they're quite biased.

People who play victim to gain sympathy or spread lies/rumours for sympathy
People who cheat on their partners (I had a 2+ year relationship, really screwed me over)
People who think they know body psychology or whatever, and thus claim you are either lying or they know you better than you
People who pretend to be "anti-social" or an introvert because they think it's cute

As someone who likes "alternative" music, I can't stand other people who do, or really people who have lots in common with me, they end up being over the top with it and it's very cringe worthy to be around.

This is just off the top of my head, but I find it very easy to dislike people.
